buttons.full: A channel can pin at most {max} buttons.
buttons.editHint: Drag to move. Right-click to edit.

picker.description: The same buttons as the Stream Deck music plugin. Pick one, then set it up.
picker.choose: Pick a button to set it up.

music-now-playing.name: Now Playing
music-now-playing.help: Toggles playback of the current track.

music-previous.name: Previous Song
music-previous.help: Goes back to the previous track.

music-set-volume.name: Set Volume
music-set-volume.help: Sets playback volume to a fixed level.

music-volume-up.name: Volume Up
music-volume-up.help: Raises playback volume by a step.

music-volume-down.name: Volume Down
music-volume-down.help: Lowers playback volume by a step.

music-volume-mute.name: Volume Mute/Unmute
music-volume-mute.help: Mutes if audible, or unmutes to a set level if muted.

music-seek.name: Seek
music-seek.help: Jumps to a set point in the current track.

music-set-repeat.name: Set Repeat Mode
music-set-repeat.help: Sets repeat to Off, Track, or Playlist/Album.

music-transfer-device.name: Switch Playback Device
music-transfer-device.help: Moves playback to a chosen device.

music-save-track.name: Save Track
music-save-track.help: Adds the current track to your Liked Songs.

music-unsave-track.name: Remove Saved Track
music-unsave-track.help: Removes the current track from your Liked Songs.

music-toggle-saved.name: Favorite Toggle
music-toggle-saved.help: Adds or removes the current track from your Liked Songs.

music-add-to-playlist.name: Add to Playlist
music-add-to-playlist.help: Adds the current track to a chosen playlist.

music-remove-from-playlist.name: Remove from Playlist
music-remove-from-playlist.help: Removes the current track from a chosen playlist.

playback.label: Playback
playback.help: Turn this off to stop all playback.

queue.title: Request queue
queue.confirmBody: Requested by {name}. It leaves the queue and {name} will not hear it.
queue.confirmBodyNoName: It leaves the queue and will not play.
queue.banBody: Requested by {name}. It leaves the queue and nobody can request it again.
queue.banBodyNoName: It leaves the queue and nobody can request it again.
queue.removeAllBody: Every song they queued leaves the queue. The song playing now keeps playing.

rules.title: Request rules
rules.empty: Not available yet. Rules show here once they can be edited.
rules.perPersonHelp: How many songs one viewer can have in the queue at a time.
rules.blockedError: The blocked songs could not load.

reset.title: Reset the request rules to their defaults?
reset.body: These rules go back to the platform default. Your edits to them are lost. The requests switch and the banger playlist stay as they are.

rules.queueSize: Songs in the queue, at most
rules.perStreamHelp: Counts songs that already played. 0 turns the cap off.
rules.bangerAutoCreate: Make a playlist on first use
rules.perRoleHelp: Songs per person by role. Leave a box blank to use the cap above.
rules.sourceRoleHint: Applies as soon as you pick it. Save does not hold it.
rules.sourceRoleFailed: {source}: who can request was not saved.
rules.youTubeMusicOnlyHelp: Only videos in the Music category or from artist (- Topic) channels.

history.title: History
history.empty: Not recorded yet. Song requests will show here.

thanks.title: Thanks for the music
thanks.subtitle: Most songs requested, all time
thanks.empty: Not recorded yet. Top requesters will show here.
thanks.error: The top requesters could not load.
